new_value: {"notes":"Fresh final correctness rereview finds the public free functions evaluate_epoch_floor/effective_epoch_floor still bypass the repaired verifier-owned primitive transaction: they accept a duck-typed fake accepts() capability and reread facade metadata outside the verifier lock. Deterministic concurrent install returned stale F+100 after live floor advanced to F+500. Restrict authoritative evaluation to exact ProvisionVerifier transactional primitives (or make free functions explicitly non-authoritative diagnostics unable to influence EpochFloorAuthority); test fake verifier, concurrent install/clear, facade mutation, and monotonic floor."}
